newsitem.title: USA: J & J Snack says hit with jury verdict.
newsitem.headline: J & J Snack says hit with jury verdict.

text.p: J & J Snack Foods Corp said Wednesday that earlier this month a jury in Los Angeles returned a verdict against the company in litigation brought by a former employee alleging same-sex harassment by a company supervisor.
The company said the verdict was for $1.7 million compensatory plus $2.5 million punitive damages. The company also said attorney's fees could be awarded.
The company said that once judgment is entered, the trial judge will review the verdict and the company can subsequently appeal.
The company said it believes the verdict is an example of a runaway jury, and that it bears little relation to the facts or damages presented.

The company said it disagrees with the verdict, and it does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by law.
